section: SECTION 1: SCIENTIFIC PURPOSE AND BIOLOGICAL SEMANTICS
question: Why did Phase 3 transition exclusively to the Illumina platform?
reference_answer: Phase 3 shifted entirely to Illumina platform data with read lengths of 70 base pairs or longer because there was a need for higher-quality variant calling and more consistent error profiles compared to the multi-platform approach used in Phase 1.
